decisions.reason: After two years without website visibility, this narrow net-price plugin no longer benefits from strong public commitment, so even with sunk development costs management would likely reallocate effort elsewhere.
Because ERP connectivity supports the firm's stated move toward broader multichannel commerce, management would still be inclined to justify past investment and retain it despite lower visibility.
With no recent website presence and several similar tracking plugins in the portfolio, management can now treat weak results as persistent and this overlapping offer as expendable.
The product's redundancy within a cluster of similar tracking plugins weakens escalation pressures by 2022, making withdrawal the more likely choice.
Although the firm initially had reasons to persist, the absence of visible market presence over multiple years makes continued justification harder and favors ending this adjacent plugin.

This reporting plugin is close to the core business but strategically less central than multichannel integrations, so fading visibility and likely limited uptake make discontinuation more probable now.
